name: Asterra
omen: Green river valleys under a pale twin moon, where bells ring for the dead more often each week.

regions.name: Millford
regions.description: A mill village on the River Wend: thatched cottages, a stone bridge, a watermill and a market square that fills every sevenday.

regions.name: Castle Brannoc
regions.description: The seat of Lord Aldric Brannoc, a grey keep above a walled market town crowded with soldiers and petitioners.

regions.name: Thornwood
regions.description: Old forest of black oaks where charcoal burners, poachers and outlaws live beyond the lord's law.

regions.name: Greyspire Pass
regions.description: A cold pass guarded by a toll tower, the only road to the eastern kingdoms and the source of rumors about the sickness.

history.title: The Founding Oath
history.summary: Seven river clans swore fealty to the first Brannoc in exchange for protection from mountain raiders.

history.title: The Twin Lights Revealed
history.summary: Priests declared the two moons to be the eyes of the gods, founding the Chapel of the Twin Lights.

history.title: The Long Winter
history.summary: Three failed harvests; the guilds rose in power by controlling grain stores.

history.title: Greyspire Toll
history.summary: Lord Brannoc fortified the pass and taxed every caravan, enriching the castle and angering merchants.

history.title: The Coughing Sickness
history.summary: A sickness arrived with eastern caravans. The lord closed the pass; the guilds want it reopened.

hooks: The coughing sickness has reached the river villages, and the chapel blames sinners.
The Millers' Guild secretly hoards grain while prices rise.
Outlaws in Thornwood are stealing from tax wagons and giving bread to the poor.
Lord Brannoc's heir has vanished on the road to Greyspire Pass.
